summary.result: The empirical results indicate the need to establish power systems and infrastructure that enable renewable energy to contribute more effectively to greenhouse gas reduction during the low-carbon transition.
summary.background: Through empirical estimation, it also examines how efficiently renewable energy generation has reduced greenhouse gas emissions among five public power generation companies in Korea.
summary.method: Based on this framework, the greenhouse gas reduction efficiency of renewable energy generation was estimated and evaluated using data on power generation facilities and generation volume from five public power generation companies from 2015 to 2024.

summary_ko.method: 이 프레임워크를 바탕으로 2015년부터 2024년까지 5개 공공 발전사의 발전설비 및 발전량 데이터를 활용하여 신재생에너지 발전의 온실가스 감소 효율성을 추정하고 평가하였다.
summary_ko.result: 실증 결과는 저탄소 전환 과정에서 신재생에너지가 온실가스 감소에 더 효과적으로 기여할 수 있도록 발전 시스템과 인프라를 구축할 필요가 있음을 나타내었다.
